result.answer: Sixteen basketball venues near the centre of Preston are recorded as having an accessible toilet at the venue, per the Sport and Recreational Facilities List (last updated 17 December 2024). Distances are straight-line metres. Judith Scott Memorial Reserve is recorded as not having accessible accessible parking.
